us_fund_flows_by_class.measure: net new cash = sales - redemptions (reinvested distributions excluded, as EPFR and ICI do)

us_fund_flows_by_country.measure: net new cash of US mutual funds, ETFs and closed-end funds (funds of funds excluded), split by each fund's holdings in the same filing; the latest months fill in as later filings arrive

us_equity_flows_by_industry.measure: equity part of net new cash of US mutual funds, ETFs and closed-end funds (funds of funds excluded), split by the SEC industry code of each holding's company

flows_vs_fed_z1.note: SEC-reported net new cash of US mutual funds, ETFs and closed-end funds against the Fed's Financial Accounts, quarter by quarter. The Fed's level runs higher (see COVERAGE.md).

reported_vs_inferred.note: How close the assets-and-returns estimate gets to reported flows for the same fund and quarter; it runs low because it cannot see distributions paid.

sources.authority: Bank for International Settlements, central bank total assets (dataflow WS_CBTA 1.0): 53 central banks, monthly, own currency (as published) and US dollars at the BIS end-of-month rate

Bank for International Settlements: locational banking statistics (WS_LBS_D_PUB: banks' cross-border claims and liabilities by reporting country and claims on each counterparty country by currency) and total credit to the non-financial sector (WS_TC 2.0: governments, companies, households, 48 areas), quarterly

Bank for International Settlements: international debt securities (WS_DEBT_SEC2_PUB 1.0) by borrower nationality, residence, kind of borrower and currency with a world total; debt securities statistics (WS_NA_SEC_DSS 1.0) by country and kind of borrower, nominal, US dollars; quarterly
Bank for International Settlements, Global Liquidity Indicators (WS_GLI)

Bank of Japan, Flow of Funds Accounts: every sector's holdings of Japanese listed shares, government bonds and Treasury bills, with transactions and price changes, quarterly from end-1997; the discontinued 1968 SNA accounts from end-1964

Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan), Flow of Funds (JSON API files FL02_en financial assets and liabilities, FL01_en financial transactions): who holds Taiwan's listed shares and government securities, by domestic sector and the rest of the world, yearly at 31 December

CFTC Commitments of Traders, Traders in Financial Futures, futures only (dataset gpe5-46if): long, short and spread positions of dealers, asset managers, leveraged funds, other reportables and non-reportables, and open interest, for every financial futures contract, weekly from 2006-06-13

Department of Investment and Public Asset Management, Ministry of Finance: the Government of India's shares in listed central public sector enterprises and in public sector banks and insurers, number of shares and market value, and each company's total market value, rupees crore, as of the page's last update (no history on the site)
European Central Bank Data Portal (SDMX), Eurosystem weekly financial statement

European Central Bank, investment fund statistics (dataflow IVF): euro-area investment funds by type and by where they are set up (euro area, Ireland, Luxembourg, Germany, France, Netherlands): total assets, fund shares in issue and net transactions, monthly from December 2008; holders inside and outside the euro area, quarterly

ECB and Eurostat, Quarterly Sector Accounts (dataflow ESTAT,QSA,1.0 on the ECB Data Portal): who holds listed shares and government debt securities issued in the euro area, Germany, France and the Netherlands, by resident sector and non-residents, stocks and transactions
Federal Reserve Board, Financial Accounts of the United States (Z.1), bulk CSV release: holders of each instrument by sector
Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED), redistributing Federal Reserve Board H.4.1/H.6/H.8/H.10/Z.1, US Treasury, Bank of Japan
Gold holders: IMF reserves template (official gold by country), US Treasury gold reserve, SPDR Gold Shares and iShares Gold Trust

International Monetary Fund, Currency Composition of Official Foreign Exchange Reserves (COFER, dataflow IMF.STA:COFER 7.0.1): world official foreign exchange reserves by currency of denomination, quarterly from 1999
International Monetary Fund, exchange rates (IMF.STA ER 4.0.1): domestic currency per US dollar, end of period and period average, monthly and yearly from 1957, about 226 countries

International Monetary Fund, Global Debt Database (IMF.FAD GDD 2.0.0): debt of households, non-financial companies, the private sector, general and central government, the public sector and public companies as a share of GDP, and nominal GDP in domestic currency, yearly from 1950, about 190 economies

International Monetary Fund, Government Finance Statistics, statement of operations (IMF.STA GFS_SOO 12.0.0): revenue by kind of tax, expense by economic type, interest, expenditure, net operating balance and net lending, for general government and each level inside it, own currency, yearly, 195 countries

IMF Government Finance Statistics, balance sheet (dataflow IMF.STA GFS_BS 12.0.0): every government's net worth, non-financial assets and financial assets and liabilities by instrument, end of year, own currency, by level of government

International Monetary Fund, Government Finance Statistics, expenditure by function (IMF.STA GFS_COFOG 11.0.0): the ten functions of the UN Classification of the Functions of Government and total outlays, by level of government, own currency, yearly, 195 countries

International Monetary Fund, Government Finance Statistics, stocks and flows by counterparty (IMF.STA GFS_SFCP): government liabilities owed to domestic and foreign creditors and, where published, to each kind of creditor, by level of government, own currency, yearly

International Monetary Fund, International Trade in Goods by partner (IMF.STA IMTS, formerly Direction of Trade Statistics): each country's goods exports (FOB) and imports (CIF) with every partner, US dollars, yearly from 1948, about 217 reporting countries

International Monetary Fund, Monetary and Financial Statistics, depository corporations survey (IMF.STA MFS_DC 8.0.0): broad money and its counterparts (net foreign assets, net claims on central government, claims on state and local government, public companies, other financial companies and the private sector) and the liabilities not counted as money, about 148 countries monthly (the United States, the euro area and Argentina quarterly), domestic currency
IMF Portfolio Investment Positions by counterpart economy (formerly CPIS): each reporting country's holdings of every other country's shares and bonds, by kind of holder

International Monetary Fund, International Reserves and Foreign Currency Liquidity (IRFCL): each country's official reserve assets and main lines (foreign currency reserves, gold, SDRs, IMF reserve position, derivatives, loans, other), monthly, US dollars, monetary authorities and central government

International Monetary Fund, World Economic Outlook (IMF.RES WEO 9.0.0): GDP in US dollars, own currency and PPP, population, general government revenue, expenditure, net lending, primary balance, gross and net debt, current account, exports, imports, external debt, inflation and real growth, yearly from 1980, about 190 economies and country groups; projections left out

Ministry of Finance, Government of India: Union Budget at a Glance workbook (receipts, expenditure, deficits and their financing, transfers to states), last actual year, budget and revised estimates, next budget estimate, rupees crore; plus the yearly Budget at a Glance tables of the 2019-20 to 2023-24 and 2025-26 budgets (actuals from 2017-18)

Controller General of Accounts, Ministry of Finance: Monthly Accounts Dashboard workbook (Union government tax heads, devolution, non-tax and capital receipts, main spending heads, deficits), fiscal year to date by month from April 2014, rupees crore

GST Network / GST Council statistics (gst.gov.in): gross and net GST collections and refunds each month, by tax (CGST, SGST, IGST, compensation cess), domestic and imports, rupees crore, from April 2024 (April 2023 as printed a year later)
SEBI shareholding-pattern filings (XBRL, Table III) as stored by the terminal (vistas/shareholding_xbrl.py), valued at NSE month-end market caps (vistas/nse_mcap.py)

Norges Bank Investment Management: every holding of Norway's Government Pension Fund Global (listed companies with value, ownership and voting share; bond issuers; unlisted real estate and renewable infrastructure by country), NOK and USD, year ends from 1998 (real estate 2011, renewables 2021) and half-years from 2024

Federal Reserve Bank of New York, Markets Data API: System Open Market Account holdings by type of security (weekly from July 2003, par value) and overnight reverse repo operations with the split by counterparty type (money market funds, government-sponsored enterprises, banks, primary dealers)
OECD monetary aggregates (DSD_STES@DF_MONAGG 4.0): broad money and narrow money, monthly, national currency and definition, 29 economies and the euro area

OECD financial balance sheets, non-consolidated, quarterly (DSD_NASEC20@DF_T720R_Q): equity, listed shares and debt securities issued by residents of about 40 economies and the part held by non-residents, with residents holdings of every issuer and of foreign issuers as the cross-check; national currency

Office of Management and Budget, Historical Tables published with the President's Budget: receipts, outlays and surplus or deficit yearly from 1901 (1.1), receipts by source from 1934 (2.1), outlays by function from 1940 (3.1) and by agency from 1962 (4.1), federal debt at the end of the year from 1940 (7.1); the final annual figures behind the Monthly Treasury Statement's first-published ones

Office for National Statistics, UK Economic Accounts: every sector's holdings of UK gilts, Treasury bills and listed UK shares, with quarterly net acquisition; gilts and bills from 1987, listed shares from 1990

US Treasury OFAC Specially Designated Nationals list and consolidated non-SDN list; UK Sanctions List (FCDO): every listed person, company, ship and aircraft with programme or regime, measures, designation date and identifiers
US SEC, Form 13F data sets
US SEC, Form N-CEN data sets (fund census - ETF flag, index flag, service providers)
US SEC, Form N-MFP data sets (money market fund holdings, repo counterparties)
US SEC, Form N-PORT quarterly flattened data sets (Division of Economic and Risk Analysis)
US SEC, EDGAR bulk company submissions (SIC industry code, tickers, former names, LEI per filer)

Statistics Canada, National Balance Sheet Accounts (table 36-10-0580-01): holders of Canadian listed shares, federal, provincial, local and corporate bonds, federal short-term paper and mutual fund units by sector including non-residents, market value, quarterly from 1990; cross-checked against the international investment position (table 36-10-0039-01)

US Treasury, Treasury International Capital system, annual surveys of cross-border portfolio holdings: foreign holdings of US securities by country and security type (SHL/SHLA, history file shlhistdat.txt, 1974-2025) and US holdings of foreign securities by issuer country (SHC/SHCA, shchistdat.txt, 1994-2024)

US Treasury, Bureau of the Fiscal Service: Financial Report of the U.S. Government on the Fiscal Data API — balance sheet (assets, liabilities, net position), statement of net cost by agency, statement of operations and changes in net position; fiscal years 1995-2025, US dollars billions
US Treasury, Treasury International Capital (TIC): major foreign holders of Treasury securities by country

US Treasury, Bureau of the Fiscal Service, Fiscal Data API: Monthly Treasury Statement tables 4, 5, 6 and 9 (receipts by tax, outlays by agency and bureau, outlays by function, financing of the deficit) monthly from March 2015, the statement's monthly totals from October 1980, Debt to the Penny every business day from April 1993, interest expense by security from May 2010

World Bank, World Development Indicators: market capitalisation of listed domestic companies (CM.MKT.LCAP.CD), US dollars, end of year, by economy; compiled from the exchanges via the World Federation of Exchanges
